name: figma-workspace
description: Stateless fixed-leaf npm command entrypoints and a shared typed Node.js runtime for explicit-target Figma workspace automation.

interface.shortDescription: Automate Figma through stateless fixed-leaf npm commands and a shared typed runtime.
interface.longDescription: Provides stateless plugin-root npm command entrypoints backed by one shared typed Node.js runtime for repairable .figma.ts workflows, explicit Figma targets, project docs, Plugin API lookup, live upstream discovery, diagnostics, assets, captures, and mutation recovery. Each remote invocation supplies its own target; shell scripts own local orchestration.
